states.meaning: Stop before the stop line and remain stopped until permitted to proceed.

signals.name: Amber / Yellow

states.meaning: Stop if it is safe to do so; proceed only where stopping cannot safely be made.

signals.meaning: Amber/yellow warns of transition to stop and requires appropriate action.

signals.name: Green

states.meaning: Proceed subject to junction conditions, pedestrians and other applicable rules.

signals.meaning: Green permits movement subject to other road conditions and controls.

signals.name: Flashing Red

states.meaning: Treat the signal as a stop control and proceed only when safe and permitted.

signals.meaning: Flashing red is a stop control requiring careful compliance.

signals.name: Flashing Amber / Yellow

states.meaning: Proceed with caution and give appropriate attention to conflicting traffic and pedestrians.

signals.meaning: Flashing amber indicates caution rather than an unconditional free movement.
